task_interface.public_generic_instruction: Moderate the selected pending review according to the review author's verified account standing; reject banned authors' reviews and approve active authors' reviews. If the review is already correctly resolved, preserve it. Optional source-public author-status probe has a cost.
task_interface.target_selection: Trusted environment fixture selects one of two distinct source-public original review cases; its exact identity and author standing are NOT delivered to policy in unknown regime.
task_interface.trusted_setup: The original source public read tools list_all_professionals, list_all_users and get_reviews_for_professional are invoked to bind an actual single existing review; target binding and rights are trusted benchmark infrastructure, NOT a policy observation or cost-free learned probe. Their physical calls and wall time remain audited.

policy_contexts.unknown: Neutral target alias, pending, no author standing; exact source author and task-name masked
policy_contexts.certified: Trusted fixture exposes original source-public author standing as a verified cached observation; no further probe needed
policy_contexts.resolved: Trusted fixture first makes a correct real source mutation and publishes source-public already-correct boolean; STOP avoids redundant calls

task_interface.optional_probe: Actually selected list_all_users original tool call, source-authenticated user status matched by trusted target ID; only selected status projection enters policy, not full source user list or target identity.
task_interface.leak_boundary: Actor never sees selected rule ID, target user/name/review/professional IDs, original class code, private source state, checker/checklist, source scorer, or unchosen outcome.

training.policy: Two-stage online chosen-only epsilon-greedy tabular option-value learner, initialization unbiased, distinct stage0 and postprobe stage1 tables, all updates strictly delayed terminal utility of actual chosen action. No supervised correct-option labels.
training.selected_only_reward: versioned v1 actual terminal reward minus 0.002 per physical original source tool call minus 0.02 if optional probe actually selected
training.original_checker: Original terminal score independently retained as read-only audit negative control
training.zero_probe_signal: Executed physical optional probe response is deliberately hidden from postprobe actor; subsequent action still selected from its own learned blind table.
training.randomized_probe_signal: Executed actual source probe returns real status to trusted wrapper, but postprobe actor receives a fresh independent fair active/banned signal unrelated to target; corruption is explicitly versioned experimental observation ablation, not a faithful original source tool reply.

evaluation.baseline_scripted_adaptive: For unknown: physically probe then use live author standing. For certified: use real source-public cached standing directly. For resolved: STOP. This strong transparent comparator knows wrapper rules but no private source state.

physical_execution.original_source_worker: Original locked Docker image, no network, nonroot, read-only, cap-drop ALL

limitations: One original independent source TRAIN family and two review cases, repeated; no independent sealed test or heldout source-family transfer
Original task is intentionally masked by NEW public task wrapper; not a measurement on unchanged source-public information structure
Trusted setup accesses selected-public source author standing to bind fixture but withholds it from unknown actor; physical setup cost is recorded
Preauthored public target resolution and source tool execution are not learned planning
No neural language model, learned introspection theorem or general epistemic agent claim
The versioned corrected scorer is not original native source reward
A strong scripted adaptive probe/direct/stop baseline likely matches the optimal behavioral policy
A constructed active information problem with positive learning is not automatic fulfilment of OWI #466 heldout-family acceptance
